mapper.sql: id, period_code, contract_code, org_id, verification_status, client_code, client_name, verification_date, financial_expense_amount, provision_reversal_amount, provision_reversal_year, tax_verification_date, tax_verification_amount, bad_debt_write_off_balance, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.select:
select #{param.periodCode} period_code, d.contract_code, d.org_id, d.verification_status, d.client_code, d.client_name, d.verification_date, d.tax_verification_date, max(coalesce(d.tax_verification_amount, 0)) as tax_verification_amount, max(coalesce(d.financial_expense_amount, 0)) as financial_expense_amount, sum(coalesce(d.provision_reversal_amount, 0)) as provision_reversal_amount, max(coalesce(d.bad_debt_write_off_balance, 0)) as bad_debt_write_off_balance from eg_charge_off_summary_report d where 1 = 1 and d.period_code=#{param.periodCode} and d.del_flag = '0'
and d.contract_code like concat('%', #{param.contractCode}::text, '%')
and d.client_name like concat('%', #{param.clientName}::text, '%')
and d.org_id = #{param.orgId}
and d.org_id in
#{item}
and d.verification_status in
#{item}
and to_char(d.verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(to_date(#{param.startVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(d.verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.endVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(d.tax_verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') >= to_char(to_date(#{param.startTaxVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
and to_char(d.tax_verification_date,'YYYY-MM-DD') <= to_char(to_date(#{param.endTaxVerificationDate},'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')
group by d.contract_code, d.org_id, d.verification_status, d.client_code, d.client_name, d.verification_date, d.tax_verification_date
